rationale: The complete bundle needs a bust crop, an existing centered vertical background element, one narrow rear luminous aperture and darker front surfaces. No such existing aperture/background owner is independently frozen; native approval is false. A bust crop would also trade away the hand-to-gap-to-hull continuity. No whole-cue realization is admitted; baseline keeps its warm front work light.

The exact cue pools tears on lower eyelid margins and closes the lip seam. Alternative A1 realizes both on the same face while retaining the pressure work. A1 makes the fear explicit but reduces the baseline parted-lip concentration and adds a fine facial detail competing with the fine seal detail. Baseline chosen; no tear cue retained.

The complete source requires a porous paper/cloth carrier with fibers crossing wet/dry regions and a damp front fed by liquid contact. The pressure membrane is a clear nonporous sheet and the escaping material is airborne condensation. Calling that a capillary front would lose the actual material and contact relation. No such cue retained.

The source requires the body, low enclosing ceiling and one narrow exit to be visible with actual clearance. It explicitly describes an adult body; the frozen reference is appearance-only and supplies no adult fact. No whole-source authority is supplied. Its spatial compression cannot be treated as a mere face crop, and no compression is retained.

The source changes main-subject hair.style and hair.style.flyaway with same-hair ownership. Facial appearance and hairstyle are the one protected reference property, and there is no independently frozen hair-part owner graph qualifying this source. The final keeps the source portrait bob/fringe, adding no flyaway prescription.

This is a continuous liquid column from a visible outlet into a coherent receiving region, with water-column contact. A condensation thread through a pressure gap is not that liquid jet, and the vacuum bay is not a liquid receiving surface. No water jet is introduced.

The source is a shore-water flow corridor between breaking waves, with surface foam/sediment aligned seaward; it requires marine/aquatic primary context. The frozen spacecraft has neither waves nor shore water. Using its word corridor for the spacecraft would erase source meaning. No use.

The whole tactile cue needs a bent free flap still joined at a peel front, retained front texture, a thin edge, differently lit reverse, and exposed substrate. A2 realizes these at the same lower membrane corner. Its extra exposed gasket and reverse surface explain delamination but compete with the simple last clamp and create a second failure mechanism. Baseline chosen; no peeling flap retained.

The source stages a depicted camera and sitter opposite one another across a gap in a side view. The frozen capture camera is an unprescribed recording viewpoint, not a depicted device, and no second camera/sitter relationship is frozen. A clear pressure boundary cannot supply that missing camera owner. No use.

The source presses a person near a doorway and directs attention down a corridor from shadow. A3 retains the pressure work while turning her attention into the corridor and putting her near side in shadow. It gives suspense beyond the leak but weakens the face-gap-clamp attention line and the reference face readability. Baseline chosen; no corridor-watch cue retained.

The complete lateral-breast/bodice relation requires human and adult context plus a bounded outer contour distinguishable from arm/back. The frozen portrait establishes no adulthood and the source has no native approval. It is unrelated to the current survival boundary and cannot be reduced to a generic garment edge. No use.

The complete cue lowers a mask to reveal an unusually extended mouth on the same adult fictional face. That alters the protected portrait facial appearance and additionally needs adult context not frozen here. A space-horror label cannot authorize that facial mutation. No use.

The complete riverbank/shawl/hand-covering-face realization requires adult context and declares subject among its effects. It relocates the human into a specific folk-horror scene, and the covered face would obstruct the appearance comparison. No whole-source admission; no river/shawl motif retained.

The source makes folded organ-like tissue the outer silhouette of a fictional creature, not an organ prop beside a person. No existing creature is independently declared, and the subject is the reference-guided woman. A new creature cannot be silently supplied by a horror label. No use.

The complete transparent-partition cue includes a food tray resting in its transfer hatch and an adult attendant outside. It declares subject and broad effects on all four owners and has no native qualification. The independently chosen pressure membrane is not a food-transfer hatch; borrowing only transparent partition would discard the tray/hatch/attendant relation. No use.

The profile requires a clearly adult subject and deliberate eye-and-nose occlusion with a scene-bound contact, unfinished task and setting. The reference supplies no adult fact, and hiding that identity-bearing region would make the requested face comparison unobservable. No selected profile or occlusion duty is created.

The source contrasts a readable adult and clothing against repeated labyrinth-set boundaries; it warns against inferring actual captivity. No adult fact or repeated labyrinth construction is independently frozen. The current single pressure boundary is not a maze. No use.

The entire cue is two printed images of the same room with different depicted door counts, placed side by side. Its effects include subject and recording/relationship roles. Those print owners are not frozen and cannot replace the reference-guided subject; adding an evidentiary desk would shift the photograph to records rather than the current emergency. No use.

The full horror-comedy cue requires an adult calmly labeling a monstrous prop that dominates the same workstation. The present emergency has no monstrous prop or labeling task and no frozen adult fact. Ordinary purposeful labor alone cannot stand in for the complete contrast. No use.

The source only names concept object photography; it supplies no concrete owner/geometry or source condition that would improve this person-centered emergency. Turning the image into an object study would demote its reference-guided human subject without an admitted source realization. No source-specific visual effect retained.

The source requires surveillance or reflection context, rather than any clear surface. The membrane transmits the bay view and is not a surveillance mirror; no independent surveillance relationship is declared. No reflection capture cue retained.

The complete underwater figure/water-surface/distant-pool-ladder realization changes subject and many physical dimensions. It cannot use a spacecraft bay as a pool or equate vacuum risk with drowning, and it does not establish death. No source admission or borrowed water imagery.

The source is two rolled hair masses, each continuous with gathered scalp hair. Replacing the supplied short bob/fringe with space buns changes the protected hairstyle. The word space is an incidental homonym, not spacecraft meaning. No use.

The laboratory fashion cue requires orderly surfaces and glossy clothing against matte equipment. Its declared effects are style/setting/color, while the distinguishing garment gloss also changes appearance; it has no native approval to resolve that scope. Generic blue reflections already belong to the independent membrane, so no glossy outfit is borrowed.

The entire profile combines an enclosed working interior, a sealed exit separating hostile outside, and an internal anomaly on the exit route. The current sheet is intentionally unfinished and no internal anomaly is selected. Source effects are empty and it grants no profile selection authority here. The baseline independently carries an external boundary but does not adopt this full profile.

The full cosmic relation needs a sealed instrument chamber with one sphere/three unequal rings and matching sky arcs/dark circle through a window. No such instrument correspondence is frozen. Adding it would create a second, large explanatory comparison unrelated to closing the seal; source authority remains false. No part of the ring correspondence retained.

The EVA source requires a person outside the vehicle in a full pressure suit/helmet, portable life support and an attached tether, and its effect is subject. The source reference-guided subject is on the habitable side with visible face; outside suit staging is not admitted through this source. No EVA/tether cue retained.

New space-horror V02 requires two gauges flanking a closed hatch with different needles and a technician bracing a gloved hand. Its complete effects include locked subject and it has no native qualification. The chosen membrane is unfinished, and displayed needles would be proxy claims rather than pressure truth. No gauges or gloved-hand source cue retained.

New space-horror V64 requires a lone crew member at the frame edge beside a lit doorway, a long empty corridor and broad unlit viewport taking the rest, with no visible creature. Subject is among its complete effects and native qualification is absent. The present hand-sheet-outer-hull hierarchy is independently authored; it does not borrow the long corridor/viewport compound. No use.

The whole source gives both hands to opposite book edges, hides lower/lateral face with the book while eyes remain beyond it, and requires book plus fixed/other capture support context. Neither book nor that support setup is frozen; both hands currently perform pressure work. No book-face cue retained.

The exact optics cue needs an existing shallow convex glass lens nearly touching a flat glass plate, with reflected interference fringes belonging to the thin air gap between those same two boundaries. A bowed plastic pressure membrane is not that lens/plate pair. No Newton-ring effect is added.

The complete cue gives a hand a single connected pair of spectacles held by one temple, with those spectacles off the face. It changes pose/contact/accessory state and does not supply permission to introduce a frozen owner. Neither spectacles nor a spare working hand are part of this scene. No spectacles retained.
